concepts.title: Asking Time
concepts.explanation: Use '现在几点？' to ask the current time.
concepts.note: 几点 (jǐ diǎn) is used for asking hours.

concepts.title: Using 点 (Hour)
concepts.explanation: Use '点' to express hours in time.
concepts.example_en: I go to school at 8 o’clock.
concepts.note: 点 is only used for clock time, not duration.

concepts.title: Minutes and Seconds
concepts.explanation: Use '分' for minutes and '秒' for seconds.
concepts.note: 分钟 and 秒钟 are used for duration, not exact time.

concepts.title: Half and Quarter Time
concepts.explanation: Use '半' for half, '一刻' for 15 minutes, and '三刻' for 45 minutes.
concepts.note: 一刻 = 15 minutes, 三刻 = 45 minutes.

concepts.title: Asking When (什么时候)
concepts.explanation: Use '什么时候' to ask when something happens.
concepts.example_en: When do you go to school?
concepts.note: Structure: Subject + 什么时候 + Verb.

concepts.title: Before and After Time
concepts.explanation: Use '前' for before and '后' for after.
concepts.example_pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn qián qù xuéxiào.
concepts.example_en: I go to school before 8 o’clock.
concepts.note: Place 前/后 after the time expression.

concepts.title: Time Placement in Sentences
concepts.explanation: Time expressions usually come before the verb.
concepts.example_pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ sān diǎn chī fàn.

concepts.title: Time of Day Words
concepts.explanation: Use specific words to indicate parts of the day.
concepts.note: Examples: 早上, 下午, 晚上.

concepts.title: Days of the Week
concepts.explanation: Use '星期 + number' to express days.
concepts.note: 星期日 can also be said as 星期天.

concepts.title: Months of the Year
concepts.explanation: Use number + 月 to express months.
concepts.note: Just numbers + 月. No creativity required.

concepts.en: When do you go to school?
I go to school at 8 o’clock.

concepts.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn qián qù xuéxiào.
concepts.en: I go to school before 8 o’clock.

concepts.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn hòu huí jiā.
Wǒ xiàwǔ sān diǎn chī fàn.
